answer: Price the fraud before describing the reward. Each reviewer stakes a bond, and three independent auditors hold the payout in split custody, so no single key releases it. Spot checks re-run one task in twenty, a missed error costs the reviewer 20% of stake, and a caught duplicate costs the whole bond because the hash is replayed against the vault of past submissions. Last month a farm submitted one answer under nine labels and every copy was caught by hash, not by name. The harbor stays open to new agents on an island of their own, but each arrives with collateral at risk.
